utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? We're collecting old appliances and electronics to fix up!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't seen any fliers or anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I saw it on the community board online! Sarah's organizing it down at the community center — says they're even taking broken toasters.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard we're having a repair drive this Saturday. Did you hear that too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, a repair drive? I think I might have seen a flyer, but I can't quite remember. Are you sure it's this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's this Saturday—I saw it on the community board near the park.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Ira, the repair drive's ready. You need it now or later?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, I can pick it up now if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll bring it over to your place in five minutes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I heard a little about it. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to fix up broken household items and share spare parts. I'm coordinating the supply donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a great idea. Do you need any help sorting or collecting donations?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, have you signed up for the repair drive this Saturday? I’m trying to figure out the best time slot around drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I was thinking of going in the morning, around 10—want to meet up and head over together?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect! I can do 10, that way I’ll have the kids to school and can focus on helping out. Want to grab coffee before we go?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Oren, what's the schedule for this repair drive? I like to plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's... um, Saturday morning? Or was it afternoon? I better check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's nail down the time right now. I don't like uncertainty in my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! I'm so glad I ran into you—I've been telling everyone about the community repair drive this Saturday. You're coming, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I don't know, Quinn — where exactly are we supposed to park and drop off the broken items? I don't want to block anyone's driveway.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, we've got a whole system! Just pull into the church lot across from the park—plenty of room, and we'll have folks there to help unload.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Rosa, I heard something about a repair drive going on—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a community initiative to help neighbors fix broken items around the house—furniture, appliances, you name it. We're pooling skills and tools this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! I’ve got a wobbly chair and a toaster that’s been acting up—can I just show up with them on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A repair drive? Which one do you mean—the one for the community center or something else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I mean the one for the community shed—didn't we discuss fixing it up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, the community shed. I remember we talked about it a couple days ago. Do you have the right tools lined up already?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I hope it goes well.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, did I miss anything important?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, you didn't miss much. Just getting things set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Mina, I heard you're organizing that repair drive—I've got a whole shed full of tools if anyone needs to borrow something.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That's real handy, Gus. Do you have a working power drill and a socket set we could count on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet I do—they're in good shape, I'll bring 'em over first thing Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo, I noticed the repair drive is scheduled for tomorrow—did you mark the spot where the old fence needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the fence. I think I saw a broken section near the oak tree—good enough for the crew to find, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Did you actually tie a marker there, or are you just guessing? I’d hate for the crew to waste time searching.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're working on some repairs. Need to borrow any tools?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks, Gus. I could use a hand with a stubborn pipe under the sink, if you've got a wrench to spare.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I've got a solid pipe wrench that should do the trick. Want me to grab it and give you a hand?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope you have a clear plan for the repair drive. It's easy for these things to get messy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have enough volunteers to pull this off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I've been keeping a list, and I think we have a solid crew—but I'd feel better if we had a backup or two just in case someone cancels.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping organize the repair drive—I'd love to pitch in, maybe connect some folks from my side of the neighborhood too!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's wonderful Jules! We could really use extra hands, and having someone who knows folks on the other side would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll start rounding up a few of my friends who are handy with tools and see if they can join us next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I just checked the inventory — we've got enough nails and wood for the repair drive, but we're low on tarps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, tarps? I might have a couple in my shed. I can check when I get home.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Dane — if you've got even one or two, it'll really help us cover the roofs that need patching.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Have you heard? The Smiths are organizing a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday—they're asking everyone to bring any broken gadgets or furniture.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds wonderful! I've got a lamp that's been sitting broken for months—maybe this will finally get it fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I bet the Smiths can help with that lamp—they're pretty handy with electrical stuff.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a rush, just give me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's a neighborhood tool-sharing and fix-it event this Saturday—bring broken stuff, we'll help repair it together!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I'll try to swing by if I can. Got a busted toaster I've been meaning to look at.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I could use some help sorting tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. Just point me to where the tools are.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? We're collecting tools and supplies to help fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't heard about that yet! What kind of tools and supplies do you need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We need hammers, screwdrivers, paint, brushes—pretty much anything handy. Could you spread the word? The more hands, the better!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, I've been keeping an eye on the street, and I think the repair drive is happening near Elm and Birch. Have you seen the crew yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, haven't seen a thing. I like to know when to expect these things, you know? Keeps my day tidy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard they start at 9 sharp, usually. Best to keep clear of the intersection until lunchtime.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a look at that repair drive? Is it worth us pooling money for the fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven't had a chance to inspect it closely yet. What exactly needs fixing, and how much are they asking for?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The plumber said the main pipe is cracked and it'll cost $500 to replace. I think it's urgent, so can you check the drive today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, how's that repair drive going? Heard you were organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Right, right—I think I left the sign-up sheet somewhere... maybe by the mailbox?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: If it's by the mailbox, I’ll grab it when I check my mail later. You need me to help round up volunteers?
